453507.overview: This hack changes Megaman into Protoman as a playable character. It is the first hack released by Dragonsbrethren.

453509.overview: This MM4 Hack Rom replaces Mega Man sprites with those of Proto Man. Some cutscenes, text and color palettes were also changed. Enjoy!

453511.overview: This is a hack of Mega Man 6 that replaces Mega Man with Proto Man.

453515.overview: Proto Man 3 is a ROM hack of Mega Man 3, created by Robot to allow players to play as Proto Man instead of Mega Man. The author took great care to ensure that Proto Man’s pixels are in the proper place, with no awkward frames of animation. The graphics and palettes were changed in multiple locations, requiring the use of several utilities, including Tile Layer Pro, MM3TextEdit, MegaManFLE, and Hexposure. The author believes that the finished product is good enough to be burned onto a real NES cart.

453679.overview: Game was originally commissioned by Party Hard Wrestling and given to fans for free.

453691.overview: This is a graphical update for the game Pooyan for the NES. It makes the wolves, as well as the pigs, look more like wolves and pigs. It also upgrades the weapons, balloons, and the background level graphics.

453693.overview: In the land of Lobo, there lives a race of humanoid foxes known as the Pelusa. When a dark evil known as the Guardians rises in Lobo, a young Pelusa named Kaji must take up his blade and thwart them.

455381.overview: The popular video game star of Diamond City, Pyoro (and also that bird from the WarioWare series) now jumps into the world of NES in…Pyoro A! (the A stands for “Adventure”) collect beans and avoid obstacles to advance through the stages, as well as facing enemies featuring some of the familiar faces in the WarioWare crew. Can you beat all 25 stages? You’ll need to think fast, and act fast to win!

456210.overview: Paper Mario Bros. is a Mesen texture pack for Super Mario Bros on the NES. It features sprites from the Paper Mario series, and also supports the two-player hack of Super Mario Bros.

456619.overview: A NES demake for the GBA game Pokémon Sapphire Version. This game is the second installment of a triple pack of games, covering the content from the fourth gym to Team Aqua's Hideout in Lilycove City.

456754.overview:
This is a hack of Ice Climber for the NES. The original 4 player hack was made by Mishra with the Mario graphics added by Nesdraug.

Play as Mario, Luigi, Wario and Waluigi to rid the sewers of Brooklyn of pests.

Players 1 and 3 (Mario and Luigi) are collecting points for team ML. Players 2 and 4 (Wario and Waluigi) are collecting points for team WW.

Each player has his own life. The logic of making lives has been changed: now life is given not for corn at level 5, but for every 50,000 points, and if a team mate is dead, life is given to him.

Sprites blink because of hardware limitations. It works on real hardware with both the adapter for Famicom and the four-score. Intro with a bird skipped.

You can choose number of lives on the title screen (left/right arrows).

Jumps are now controllable.

456786.overview: Mod to add 2-player simultaneous support to the game.

457857.overview: The Ghost Monsters have invaded the mansion and stole the bonus items and fruit! With Mappy out of the picture due to either being chomped or chasing off Goro and his Meowkies elsewhere, it’s up Pac-Man to retrieve the bonus goodies!

458019.overview: Pac-Man has taken the wrong door to fairly land and ended up in subcon. Play as Pac-Man (or the other 3, Luigi, Peach and Toad) in SMB2.

458327.overview:
Travel through 5 groovy levels as both Peach and Mario in the search for the ultimate Discothèque! Mario and Peach each have an unique ability and the player can switch between them during gameplay at will.

Experience a brand new enemy, the disco Lakitu, a hip cat who can either drop helpful power ups or dangerous foes.

A new P-Wing power up will let Mario and Peach swim through the skies!

458931.overview: What if.... Artix was trapped in a Pac-Man-esque dungeon? This "byte-sized" adventure features a ghost-filled maze of rooms. Find your battle axe and battle your way to the end. Oh, and be sure to pick up power runes. They will turn the ghosts blue so you can hit them :D. Reach the end screen of this short but challenging game for ultimate bragging rights.

458982.overview:
Pet Dog, aka Chongwu Baobao is a virtual pet-raising simulator developed by Nice Code Software and published by Shenzhen Nanjing Technology. It was likely released amidst the Nintendogs craze in the 2000s. The game has the player take care of one of three dogs, which is framed as them adopting the dog in an intro sequence. The game's cartridge uses battery-backed RAM to save the player's progress, which can be loaded from the main menu.

Pet Dog would be included on multiple plug and play systems. While it functions identically to the Chinese Famicom release, it is unable to save progress on most systems it is included in.

459784.overview: A while ago, PolyGirl was getting ready to play a game on her Polystation when she suddenly found a rather strange cartridge in her collection. It had no cover, and its plastic casing was already showing signs of wear. Out of curiosity, she decided to insert it into her console to see what it was. As soon as she turned on the Polystation, a mysterious scientist calling himself Dr. Noac appeared on the screen and, as if by magic, snatched the console along with PolyGirl’s entire game collection. At that moment, a beam of light emerged from the mysterious cartridge, inviting PolyGirl to enter it. Luckily, Dr. Noac didn’t take the zapper from the console, so PolyGirl grabbed it without a second thought… and jumped straight into the cartridge.

460004.overview:
Packey and his brothers Lackey and Lackey 2 live on Turtle Island.
One day Lackey went on a scavenger hunt and did not return.
Packey found a trail of yogurt-covered raisins, Lackey's favorite treat, leading to a haunted house.
To rescue his brother, Packey must first... FIND THE RAISINS!

460056.overview:
Penguin: Sokoban Adventure is a charming puzzle game for the NES, created with Retro Puzzle Maker 1.4.4. Take control of a brave penguin on a quest to rescue his beloved girlfriend! Push blocks of ice, collect fish bones, and navigate tricky paths to reach the igloo at the end of each stage.

With 64 unique levels of varying difficulty, each one will test your logic, planning, and patience. From simple icy corridors to complex frozen mazes, every challenge brings you closer to your goal.

460222.overview: PixFight is kind of a fighting game (or maybe it's a PvP shooter?). Players need to gather resources, which allows them to build platforms, stairs, defense blocks, and mainly, to shoot each other.

460498.overview:
A story about a little creature that can clone himself.

One day during an evening walk in the mountains, Plyuk fell into a creepy cave.

Under the ground was a whole laboratory where they were experimenting on creatures like him.

Plyuk managed to escape at the perfect moment.

Your task is to help Pluck get out of the cave and return to his home village!

Don't forget that Pluyk has a special ability - he can clone himself!

461579.overview: After a violent thunderstorm, the cartridge PolyGirl had hidden was endowed with enough power to allow Dr. Noac to escape again. Feeling humiliated by his previous confrontation with that girl, he acquired the best analog devices possible to build his fortress. He also acquired more powerful allies to fulfill his goal of eliminating PolyGirl and, later, to further his plan to eradicate digital technology.

462548.overview: This is an HD pack for the Mesen NES emulator. The goal of the pack is to replace the NES sprites with several sprites from the arcade version of Popeye.

462612.overview: This is an HD pack for Pac-Man, exclusively for the Mesen NES emulator. The pack changes the original sprites to match the sprites from the arcade version.

462618.overview: Pac-Man HDNes Pack is a high resolution graphics pack for the original 1993 Namco release of Pac-Man for the NES. This pack was built and tested with Mesen 0.9.5 and features detailed spritework at four times the size of the original.

464650.overview:
There has been some weird reports of strange activity going on at the world headquarters of the "ACME JunkFood" company.

One report states that scientists at "ACME JunkFoods" have been experimenting with human genetic information and mixing it with their "junk food" products and everything went berserk!!!

Contains a single playable level, reaching the end takes you back to the title screen.

468187.overview: An untitled Kirby's Adventure ROM hack by Puresabe.

468769.overview: This game is a bootleg demake of Pokémon Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald for the NES. This is the third of three games which covers the story from after the Team Aqua Hideout in Lilycove City until the Pokémon League.

468773.overview:
Princess Peach and Princess Daisy were taking a quiet vacation away from everything in Snowbite Kingdom. The peace was shattered when Bowser stole all the presents for the holiday from a nearby town! Now Princess Peach and Princess Daisy must make their way across the Kingdom of Snowbite in order to defeat Bowser and return the presents to the village.

With Mario and Luigi all the way back in the Mushroom Kingdom, can our heroines save the day?

468876.overview: This game is a bootleg demake of Pokémon Ruby / Sapphire / Emerald for the NES. This is the second of three games which covers the story from after the 4th gym until right after the Team Aqua hideout in Lilycove City.

469967.overview:
The "Electronic Nexus for Conservation, Research and Observation of Arcade & Console History"  is pleased to announce the discovery of a historic piece: a never-dumped NES cartridge. We had some difficulties purchasing and receiving it, but it’s finally in our (and your) hands. You are invited to uncover its contents and document your findings. 

This is a 2025 homebrew game distributed through Itch.io, but it's presented as a recently discovered 1987 prototype.

470016.overview:
This is a hack of Mega Man 3.

The third and last installment of the PolyGirl's Adventure saga.

470028.overview: After the opening of a new restaurant, the forest animals started to disappear... Venture deep into the dungeon and uncover the mystery!

472092.overview: This hack completely overhauls Tengen’s NES port of Pac-Mania to feel more like the arcade version. It features redone graphics and color palettes, new music and sound effects, gameplay tweaks, and an options menu with all of the adjustable options in the arcade version, including number of lives, ability to select a world or continue, and Japanese and international stage orders.

472103.overview: The second game is based on a Russian TV-show (clone of Wheel of Fortune), developed by A. Chudov in 1997. Requires a good understanding of the Russian language.

474344.overview:
This multicart is 32 megabytes in size and contains 150 different games (there are no repeats or Nice Code Software minigames). The menu system displays a preview of each game. Pressing 'Left' or 'Right' will take the player to the previous/next menu screen and pressing 'A' or 'B' will skip 5 screens (50 games) at once.

The games are from all major regions (USA, Japan, Europe), but will work regardless of the region of your console (albeit sometimes with altered speed).

Some versions of the cartridge start with Mario on bootup screen and some with Sonic. Later revisions omit the bootup screen. Game #95 is New Ghostbusters II on the version with Mario bootup screen and Ghostbusters II on the version with Sonic bootup screen.

Some versions of the cartridge come with a working save battery, however only one game can be saved at a time (launching any other game that uses SRAM will overwrite the save data). The cartridge is also available without the battery, with a lower price.

The game list contains 4 Zapper compatible games, 3 of which are unplayable without it.

Rockman (JPN version of Mega Man)
Rockman 2: Dr. Wily no Nazo (JPN version of Mega Man 2)
Rockman 3: Dr. Wily no Saigo!? (JPN version of Mega Man 3)
Rockman 4: Aratanaru Yabou!! (JPN version of Mega Man 4)
Rockman 5: Blues no Wana!? (JPN version of Mega Man 5)
Rockman 6: Shijō Saidai no Tatakai!! (JPN version of Mega Man 6)
Wily & Light no Rockboard: That's Paradise (ENG translation)
Seirei Densetsu Lickle (JPN version of Little Samson)
Dragon Fighter
Saiyuuki World
Rush'n Attack
Jackal
Gradius
Life Force
Parodius (PAL game, but will work on NTSC NES and Famiclones)
Gun.Smoke (PAL game, but will work on NTSC NES and Famiclones)
Thundercade
Legendary Wings
Geki Kame Ninja Den (JPN version of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles)
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: The Arcade Game
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles III: The Manhattan Project
Teenage Mutant Hero Turtles: Tournament Fighters (PAL game, but will work on NTSC NES and Famiclones)
Contra (US version)
Super Contra (JPN version of Super C)
Contra Force
Final Mission (JPN version of S.C.A.T.: Special Cybernetic Attack Team)
Kage (JPN version of Shadow of the Ninja)
Super Mario Bros.
Super Mario Bros. 2 (PAL game, but will work on NTSC NES and Famiclones)
Super Mario Bros. 3 (JPN version)
Dr. Mario
Mario Bros.

474528.overview: A compilation released in Poland in 1992 by Bobmark, featuring four games from Codemasters. It was also included with the Pegasus IQ-502 console. The selection of games is different from that of Quattro Arcade for the NES.

474565.overview:
This notable compilation was brought to Poland by Bobmark, the same company responsible for distributing the iconic Pegasus console across the Polish market. In an effort to elevate their brand and deliver a high-end, premium product, Bobmark teamed up with Taiwanese company Realtec (BIC) and the renowned British developer and publisher Codemasters.

The Golden Five featured a standout selection of titles, including:

- Big Nose Freaks Out
- Micro Machine
- The Fantastic Adventures of Dizzy
- Ultimate Stuntman
- Big Nose the Caveman

Each of these games was remarkably original, uniquely designed, and stood in stark contrast to the standard library available for the Pegasus console at the time.

477530.overview:
This is a pirate multicart released by NTDEC in 1991. The cartridge label reads "Media Games 250 in 1", but it's sometimes referred to as Powerful 250-in-1, because that's written on the menu screen, or Golden 250-in-1, because of the label's gold color.

The menu screen features an 8-bit portrait of Arnold Schwarzenegger.

The multicart contains 99 unique games. The other 151 games are trainer hacks of those 99 games. 

Due to the large number of unique games on the multicart, and the fact that it's a fairly good selection of early NES games, this is considered one of the best pirate multicarts of its era, and it's become a holy grail of pirate multicart collectors.

479884.overview: This is another minor hack of Nanjing's earlier game, Kou Dai Bao Shi: Jin. This time the game has been changed so that it's a backport of Pokemon Gold. This hack features new graphics for the overworld towns. The male player is named "Jack" (杰克), and the wild trainer is a Rhyhorn.

479885.overview:
Despite the name literally translating to "Pocket Gems: Blue", this is actually an unofficial packport of Pokemon Sapphire. 

After making several original RPGs, Kou Dai Bao Shi: Lan was Nanjing's first big success, and it served as a blueprint for most of their future games: take a popular media property, be it a game, novel, movie, or television show, and adapt the story into their RPG engine. 

Due to the game's success, Nanjing made several more Pokemon games that were just minor hacks of this game.

479886.overview:
Despite the name literally translating to Pocket Gem: Red, this is actually an unofficial backport of Pokemon Ruby.

This game is a hack of Nanjing's earlier RPG Kou Dai Bao Shi: Lan made to look like Pokemon Ruby. Its title screen features a Groudon, which is the new wild Pokemon trainer. Aside from renaming the character to "Mary" (玛丽), it also replaces Brendan's front and back sprites with May, but doesn't replace the rival's sprites, making it possible to face a doppleganger battle. It also keeps Brendan's overworld sprites intact.

479887.overview: Kou Dai Zuan Shi is an unofficial backport of Pokemon Diamond. It's an uipdated version of Nanjing's earlier RPG, Kou Dai Bao Shi: Yin, which was a variant hack of Kou Dai Bao Shi: Lan.

479896.overview:
This is yet another variant hack of Nanjing's earlier RPG, Kou Dai Bao Shi: Lan, this time changed to be an unofficial backport of Pokemon Silver. It features the female player from Kou Dai Bao Shi: Hong as the main character, changing her name to "Lanlan" (兰兰) and the updated overworld graphics from Kou Dai Bao Shi: Jin. Salamence aappears as the wild trainer.

This game was later rereleased by Nanjing as Kou Dai Shui Jing with its title screen hacked so that it looks like a backport of Pokemon Crystal.

480714.overview:
An "educational computer" Famicom multicart, released in 1996 by Waixing Computer & Technology. It is reportedly the oldest known Waixing-produced Famicom title. The game would be followed by 1996 English CAI 3-in-1. 

The multicart features four games/programs:

Primary School Mathematics CAI (小学生数学 CAI) - A set of math equations. It can be set from 1st grade to 4th grade levels; each grade level features different modes and options. Uses the Subor keyboard, whereas the other three games use a standard controller.

Hua Rong Dao (华容道) - An adaption of the wooden puzzle game, better known in English as Klotski.

Count 24 Points (算24点) - An adaption of the card game 24.

Guess the Zodiac (猜生肖) - A game where the player controls a bird to guess a monkey's zodiac. The actual gameplay rules cannot be determined; it is unknown if this is based on a preexisting table game.

481283.overview: RPG with a prehistoric setting. It's likely an unofficial backport of the Korean RPG Stone Age.

482501.overview:
“LLLLLLADIES AND GENTLEMEN………!!!“

Presenting the WVBA Punch-Out!! circuit we always wanted and deserved (although we still probably deserve better artwork… sorry about that part).

Punch your way through the Rocky Circuit rankings from crybaby Tommy Gunn all the way up through the Siberian Express, Ivan Drago.  Take advice from managers Mick, Apollo and Duke.  This is your whole life here!  All your strength, all your power, all your love!  There is no tomorrow!  You get the idea.

Having trouble getting past Drago?  Clubber Lang?  Thunderlips?  Maybe a little emulator lag got you down or you’ve lost that eye of the tiger?  Don’t give up.  Just turn on ROCKY MODE and feel the movies come to life.

482699.overview: A hack of Hummer Team's pirate port of the Sega Genesis Aladdin game, which is unrelated to Virgin's official NES port. The hack changes Aladdin to Popeye. The title on both the cartridge and the box is Popeye 2, but the game's title screen has the title "Popeye II: Travels In Persia".
